The Writing Voice fixtures for frontend/tests/voiceEditor.test.ts. They are the
fixtures of the site's voice editor tests, copied byte for byte.

writer-*.md are real Voice Writer outputs, kept byte for byte: the CLI ran the
agentry/voice-writer@1.1.0 QuickAgent against a hosted inference endpoint
(openai/qwen3.8-flash-next). Each run wrote its VOICE.md to a file with
--write, so no voice was kept on the machine that made them:

  writer-create-docs.md     voice create --file <three of the site's docs pages>
  writer-create-casual.md   voice create --file <two blog posts and an email written
                            for the fixture> --brief "Keep it friendly and a bit silly."
  writer-create-formal.md   voice create --file <a report and a memo written for the
                            fixture>
  writer-edit-formal.md     voice edit --current writer-create-formal.md --file <the
                            memo> --note "Allow contractions in internal memos, and add
                            a short section on how to write an email to a colleague."

The samples hold no one's private writing. hand-short.md is the hand-written voice
of the CLI's attach check; hand-every-node.md is written for this
test and holds every block and mark the editor keeps.
